base_member_text: [L425-L449] (LOW/unchecked enum) Cyclic boundary handling has cases only for 0 and 1; any other value leaves out-of-range neighbor ranks in place without setting boundary flags or returning an error.
audit_member_text: [L425-L449] (MED/input-validation) Cyclic boundary handling has cases only for 0 and 1 and no default, so any other cyclic value leaves negative or out-of-range neighbor ranks marked as non-boundaries.

base_member_text: [L314-L320,L1696-L1701,L1711-L1727] (HIGH/incorrect abort communicator) Normal error handling aborts xmpi_comm, which excludes the output rank and is MPI_COMM_NULL on that rank, so output-rank failures can recurse or hang and compute-rank failures can strand the output process.
audit_member_text: [L257-L260,L314-L320,L1696-L1701,L1711-L1727] (HIGH/mpi/error-path) The I/O rank deliberately has xmpi_comm set to MPI_COMM_NULL, yet normal halt and communicator error handling call xmpi_abort on xmpi_comm, so an error on that rank can attempt MPI_Abort with an invalid communicator instead of terminating the full job.

base_member_text: [L1619-L1671] (MED/unchecked row contract) xmpi_getrow does not validate n, prow, or b's extent before assigning a full row and communicating n elements.
audit_member_text: [L1619-L1670] (MED/mpi/input-contract) xmpi_getrow does not validate prow, n, size(a,2), or size(b), so inconsistent metadata can produce invalid ranks, nonconforming assignment, buffer mismatch, or an unmatched blocking receive.

base_member_text: [L690-L771] (MED/message-size contract) All xmpi_sendrecv wrappers use the sender's size as the receive count without verifying that recvbuf has the same number of elements.
audit_member_text: [L690-L773] (MED/buffer-size-contract) All sendrecv overloads reuse size(sendbuf) as the receive count without checking recvbuf size, permitting receive truncation or overwrite for mismatched arguments.

base_member_text: [L371-L376] (HIGH/division by zero) The XPREF processor-grid branch can set nmin to zero and evaluate m/nmin; Fortran does not guarantee short-circuit evaluation of the preceding nmin>4 condition.
audit_member_text: [L371-L372] (HIGH/arithmetic) The XPREF condition can evaluate m/nmin when integer division n/xmpi_size produced zero, because Fortran does not require short-circuit evaluation of .and., yielding a division by zero.

base_member_text: [L210-L249,L311,L494-L639,L701-L857,L1387-L1583,L1613,L1660-L1670] (LOW/unchecked MPI status) Most MPI return codes are assigned but not inspected locally, reducing diagnostic context even where a communicator error handler may run.
audit_member_text: [L1568-L1585] (MED/mpi/liveness) xmpi_send_sleep ignores all MPI errors and polls forever until flag becomes true, so a failed Irecv or MPI_Test has no exit path.

base_member_text: [L648-L683] (MED/string buffer bounds) Character broadcast sends the source's trimmed length but never checks the receiving character capacity before assigning x(i:i), so differing declared lengths can write past the receiver.
audit_member_text: [L648-L687] (MED/bounds-contract) Character broadcast does not verify that non-source character variables can hold the source's trimmed length before assigning x(i:i).

base_member_text: [L484,L500,L515,L530,L545,L560,L575,L589,L603,L617,L631,L645] (HIGH/build dependency) Twelve active broadcast wrappers include xmpi_bcast.inc, but that include is absent from the source tree and is not listed among the build's generated sources.
audit_member_text: [L481-L645] (HIGH/build-completeness) Fourteen broadcast wrappers include xmpi_bcast.inc, but that include is absent from the source_code tree, leaving these procedures uncompilable unless an undocumented external generation step supplies it.

base_member_text: [L1730-L1755] (MED/diagnostic crash) On compiler configurations that leave MBACKTRACE defined, the error reporter deliberately dereferences a null pointer to force a segmentation fault before orderly MPI termination.
audit_member_text: [L1730-L1755] (HIGH/preprocessor/error-path) The GNU-version test checks __GNUC_MINOR__ >= 8 even for major versions above 4, so many modern GNU compilers retain the fallback backtrace routine that intentionally dereferences a null pointer on every normal halt.

base_member_text: [L1374-L1560] (MED/message-size contract) The paired xmpi_send wrappers derive counts independently from the sender and receiver actual arrays and exchange no shape metadata, so mismatched caller shapes yield truncation or partial data.
audit_member_text: [L1374-L1560] (MED/mpi/message-contract) The paired send helpers derive counts independently from each rank's local array and do not validate from/to ranks, so shape disagreement or invalid endpoints can cause truncation or indefinite blocking.

base_member_text: [L145-L151,L961-L980] (HIGH/missing generic implementation) xmpi_shift_i3 calls xmpi_sendrecv with rank-3 integer sections, but the xmpi_sendrecv generic has no rank-3 integer procedure, producing no matching specific routine.

audit_member_text: [L201-L214,L307-L312] (MED/mpi/lifecycle) The module unconditionally initializes and finalizes MPI without checking existing MPI state, conflicting with embedding hosts that own the MPI lifecycle.

[L338-L387] (LOW/integer-range) Processor-grid scoring uses default-integer products and a fixed 1000000000 sentinel, allowing large domain dimensions to overflow or leave a valid factorization unselected.
dispositions.rationale: span-confirmed: The fixed sentinel can prevent selection even without integer overflow: with two processes and m=n=1000000000 both candidate scores equal the sentinel, so neither satisfies the strict comparison. The subsequent minimum-domain tests do not repair an unselected processor grid.

audit_member_text: [L359-L365] (MED/input-validation) Manual decomposition checks only the product, so two negative manual dimensions can pass and later become invalid divisors and neighbor geometry.
dispositions.rationale: span-confirmed: Two negative factors whose product equals xmpi_size pass this branch, and the later minimum-domain comparisons against negative processor dimensions do not reject them. params.F90 reads mmpi/nmpi without strict checking, and readkey_int only warns for values below its recommended minimum.

audit_member_text: [L614-L626] (LOW/mpi/portability) Eight-byte integer broadcast uses nonstandard integer*8 syntax and the nonportable MPI_INTEGER8 datatype rather than a kind-matched MPI type.
[L820-L838,L850-L858] (MED/buffer-size-contract) Array reductions send size(x) elements into y without asserting equal extents, leaving root receive-buffer capacity implicit.
[L873-L989] (MED/bounds-contract) Basic shift routines directly reference rows or columns 2, m-1, and n-1 without validating minimum local-array extents.
[L1030-L1208] (MED/bounds-contract) Ranged shift routines accept arbitrary i1/i2 and derive sections from a fixed four-cell overlap without checking ordering or bounds.

[L1603-L1614] (MED/mpi/communicator-contract) xmpi_barrier defaults to xmpi_comm even though that communicator is MPI_COMM_NULL on the I/O process, and the procedure contains no guard against invocation there.
